name: Fed10
long_description:
Fed10 is a legislative consulting firm staffed by AI agents. 

We monitor every bill across the U.S., flag threats to your business, and deliver actionable insights — the same work a $500/hr policy consultant does, but in seconds instead of days.

Built by three ex-lobbyists who passed legislation together.

launches.title: Fed10 🇺🇸 – AI Lobbyists
launches.tagline: Harvey for Public Policy/Government Affairs teams
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** We use AI to ingest every proposed regulation in the world and immediately flag threats to your business. We help companies catch bills that would cost them millions in compliance, draft the fix, and show them who to call and what to say to get it done.

[**Launch Video:**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q5xti-2WC1Y)

Hey, we’re [Armand](http://linkedin.com/in/armand-iorgulescu), [Zayan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/drowsy/), and [Winston](https://www.linkedin.com/in/winstonwei-wc/). We’re ex-lobbyists who passed legislation before we could even vote, and now we’re building Fed10.

**The problem**\
Every company is affected by regulation. Most don't find out until it's too late.

Your options today: 

* Pay $30K/month for policy consultants or lobbyists to stop threats
* Get blindsided

Even the companies that pay still get burned. We watched one of our bills die in Nevada because a last-minute committee change happened and the consultants we were paying missed it.

Public policy teams spend most of their time on research when they should be spending it on the relationships that actually move legislation.

**What Fed10 does**

Our AI agents handle the research. Every regulation, every jurisdiction, monitored in real time. When something threatens your business, we flag it, draft the fix, and pair you with the right person to get it handled.

One user had a bill that would have cost them $10M/yr in compliance. We caught it, drafted the amendment, and delivered a full advocacy strategy. That took seconds, not the weeks a consultant would need.

**The team**

In high school, we led immigrant advocacy campaigns, drafted bills, advocated for them, and got them signed into law that now affect 344,000 people annually. We dropped out of Harvard, Williams, and Berkeley to build this.

**The ask**

* **Run policy or government affairs for your company?** → Try [Fed10](https://www.fed10.ai) and email [armand@fed10.ai](mailto:armand@fed10.ai)
* **Don’t have a policy team but still affected by regulation?** →Try [Fed10](https://www.fed10.ai) and email [armand@fed10.ai](mailto:armand@fed10.ai)
* **Know someone who does?** → Send them this post
